end.summary:
Read and wrote some 4-digit numbers in numerals and words.
Practised place value: thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.
Expanded 4 tens and 2 ones as 42; identified 6042 and 7008.
Practised numbers with internal zeros, including 3050 and 4050.
Mixed up writing “four thousand fifty” as 4050; this was not corrected after the last occurrence.
end.parentNote: Diya practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers, place value, and expanded form. They used place-value language correctly in several examples, including identifying thousands, tens, and ones. They mixed up how to write “four thousand fifty,” combining the spoken parts as 4050; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Diya to build numbers such as 4,050 with digit cards and say each place value, including the zero hundreds and zero ones.
